    local rpBioText = "welcome dear " .. playerName

    task.spawn(function()
        -- Wait for Brookhaven RE Remote Folder
        local re = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RE", 10)
        if re then
            local rpNameEvent = re:FindFirstChild("RPName") or re:WaitForChild("RPName", 5)
            local rpBioEvent = re:FindFirstChild("RPBio") or re:WaitForChild("RPBio", 5)

            -- Retry mechanism to guarantee server registration

        end
    end)
end

        if chatEvent and chatEvent:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest") then

    end)
    
    -- Modern TextChatService
    pcall(function()
        local textChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

            local generalChannel = textChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")

                generalChannel:SendAsync(msg)
            end
        end
    end)
end
